currency.basis: Live site fetched 2026-10-03; the red #DB0124 figure and wordmark are the current branding, continuing after the 2025 ownership change.

identity.basis: homecredit.kz redirects to home.kz, the official site of the bank recorded as Банк Хоум Кредит (KZ); the SVG is the bank's own published logo asset.

assessment.independenceRationale: Both observations come from the bank's own live site (logo SVG and favicon set, same fetch context); identity anchored by record metadata and the domain redirect.
uncertainties: Standalone-figure presentation is confirmed by raster favicon/app icons (research-only); the vector for the standalone figure is the 'O' sub-shape of the official combined-logo vector, presented via a viewport crop that changes no path geometry.

variant.basis: Current variant is the standalone red figure on transparent; the base icon is the older presentation (crimson disc, white figure). Same underlying symbol, presentation/color update.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Ring, inner opening and the head/smile shape render crisply at 240px on both themes; uniform #DB0124; no clipped strokes after the crop (bounds verified against the source raster).
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The figure's own aspect (~126x92) is preserved by the crop viewBox; in the square catalog cell it letterboxes centered without stretching, matching the standalone favicon presentation.
candidate.rationale: The bank's own live site (home.kz, reached from homecredit.kz) publishes this vector logo and uses the arch figure standalone in its favicon/app icons; the base icon is the older presentation of the same symbol (crimson #C8102E disc with inverted white figure). Supported currency/presentation update from an original, receipt-bound vector.
candidate.role: standalone-symbol: the current brand presents the figure alone on transparent (site favicon/apple-touch icons); no branded circular backing is used in the current variant, so none was invented.
transforms: Working SVG derived from the original downloaded vector by viewport crop only: the original single path is byte-unchanged; viewBox set to the figure's bounding region (110.86 11.61 126.28 92.05) so only the 'O' figure of HOME shows, matching the bank's standalone-figure usage; the paint attribute serialization was normalized to fill="#DB0124" with the identical color taken from the original .st0 CSS class.

candidate.variant: red #DB0124 arch figure on transparent; replaces the older white-figure-on-#C8102E-disc badge
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Deliberate presentation update: the enclosed-disc badge is replaced by the bank's current standalone open figure in the current red. Source-versus-final shows no unintended difference — the final is literally the same vector sub-shape.

proposals.reason: The current official mark of Home Credit Bank Kazakhstan (home.kz, legal brand unchanged after ForteBank's 2025 majority acquisition) is the red 'person under arch' figure used standalone — it is the 'O' of the HOME wordmark in the bank's official vector logo (Logotip_banka, #DB0124) and appears alone in the site favicon and app icons. The base icon shows the same figure in an older crimson #C8102E inside an inverted filled disc (white figure on red circle); the current standalone presentation is the red figure itself on transparent. Supported currency/presentation update from an original vector.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official bank vector logo (https://home.kz/strapi/uploads/Logotip_banka_36d8b1bd8d.svg, viewBox 0 0 500 334.23, #DB0124, receipt-bound fetch) served by the bank's own site; the same site's favicon and app icons (raster, research-only) show the arch figure standalone, confirming the standalone-symbol presentation. The figure is the literal 'O' sub-shape of the original vector.

sources.observation: homecredit.kz now serves https://home.kz; header logo raster (research-only) and the official SVG logo use the red arch figure + HOME CREDIT BANK wordmark in #DB0124.
Site favicon/apple-icon PNGs (research-only, 96/180px) show the red arch figure standalone on transparent, matching the proposed standalone presentation.
